summary: Comprehensive testing of Walt the GOAT fitness PWA with AUTH_DISABLED mode - Complete success. All authentication removed, free access enabled. Backend 100% (16/16 API tests passed), Frontend 100% (all pages functional with demo user).

backend_issues.notes: All 16 backend API endpoints working perfectly without authentication. Demo user system functional.

frontend_issues.notes: Complete frontend functionality verified: free access homepage, all navigation working, demo user properly displayed, timer functionality, stats display, challenges system all operational.

passed_tests: Backend: Health endpoint returns 'Walt the GOAT' app info
Backend: Auth /api/auth/me returns demo user without session token
Backend: Profile endpoints work with demo user
Backend: Walks API (GET/POST) functional with GPS tracking
Backend: Circuits API (GET/POST) with per-set exercise tracking
Backend: Exercises API returns exactly 26 exercises as required
Backend: Plans generation API creates age-appropriate workouts for demo user
Backend: Stats API returns comprehensive analytics and chart data
Backend: Sfide generation API creates 3 challenges as expected
Backend: Sfide progress tracking API functional
Frontend: Homepage loads directly without login - shows 'Buon pomeriggio, Demo User!'
Frontend: All 5 navigation pages accessible (Home, Camminata, Circuito, Stats, Sfide)
Frontend: Bottom navigation visible and functional on all pages
Frontend: Home page shows quick action buttons (Camminata, Circuito)
Frontend: Camminata page displays timer (00:00:00), Avvia Camminata button, walk history
Frontend: Circuito page shows exercise/circuit content
Frontend: Stats page displays comprehensive statistics with Italian UI
Frontend: Sfide page shows active challenges (Volume monster, Streak di fuoco) and completed challenges
Frontend: Walt the GOAT mascot visible across pages
Frontend: Italian language interface throughout entire app
Frontend: Navigation between all pages working correctly
success_percentage: Backend: 100% (16/16 tests passed), Frontend: 100% (all required features verified functional)
